stations.title: Imogen
stations.say: Why did the cafe get 31 tins?

stations.title: Cafe till
stations.text: Sends values the code never checks.

captions: Imogen asks why the cafe on Mill Street was sent thirty-one tins.
The till sent the tins as text, and the code used them without a check.
You give each value from outside an honest type and check it before use.
Now the cafe's order comes through as the four tins they asked for.
What arrives from the till is checked, and a status nobody handled stops the code.
